``` { .yaml .annotate linenums="1" }
services:
  nut:
    container_name: nut
    image: instantlinux/nut-upsd:2.8.5-r1@sha256:a4a68e3c56081e3187621ee2a4bf9bce2936eaf0b628c01f81881f25cee0e667
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    environment:
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-e", "-c"]  # (1)!
    command:
      - |
        cat /run/secrets/nut_smc_ups_conf_v1 > /etc/nut/ups.conf
        printf 'LISTEN 0.0.0.0 3493\n' > /etc/nut/upsd.conf
        : > /etc/nut/upsd.users
        chgrp nut /etc/nut/*
        chmod 640 /etc/nut/*
        mkdir -p -m 2750 /dev/shm/nut
        chown nut:nut /dev/shm/nut
        [ -e /var/run/nut ] || ln -s /dev/shm/nut /var/run/nut
        upsdrvctl -u nut start
        exec upsd -u nut -F
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "upsc", "ups-smc@localhost", "ups.status"]
      interval: 60s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
    ports:
      - 3494:3493  # (2)!
    volumes:
      - type: bind  # (3)!
        source: /mnt/fast/configs/nut/ups.conf
        target: /run/secrets/nut_smc_ups_conf_v1
        read_only: true
        bind:
          create_host_path: false

  nut-exporter:
    container_name: nut-exporter
    image: ghcr.io/druggeri/nut_exporter:3.3.0@sha256:276460d141c732772f8b1fcd785a7de272473e6d39fd85c32b163efc2999cb9a
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    command:
      - --nut.server=nut  # (4)!
      - --nut.serverport=3493
      - --web.listen-address=:9199
    ports:
      - 9198:9199
    depends_on:
      - nut
```

1.  the image's entrypoint runs `upsmon` as a monitor, with a password and a shutdown command the
    image does not have, and this stack only serves reads. so the command below does the server
    part the way the image's script does, writing the NUT files, starting the driver as `nut` and
    running `upsd` in the foreground as `nut`, with no `upsd.users`, so nothing can log in.
2.  `3493` on this host is truenas1's own NUT server, for `ups-truenas`. PeaNUT and gatus read this
    one at `192.168.1.86:3494`.
3.  the SNMPv3 keys are two lines of this file and NUT reads them from nowhere else, so the file is
    the secret: bound read-only and copied into place by the first line of the command. with
    `create_host_path: false` a missing file fails the deploy, where docker would otherwise create a
    directory in its place.
4.  the exporter reads the `upsd` beside it by service name, on the container's `3493`. the host's
    exporter on `9199` cannot: its `serverport` parameter is ignored as of 3.3.0, so it reaches
    only servers on `3493`, and this one is on `3494`.
